name: nimbus
description: NIMBUS — Newell Integrated Batch & Unified Scheduling. Static frontend with no runtime bundler; this package.json backs the ESLint static-analysis gate and a per-file (non-bundling) TypeScript build for modules that have been migrated — see docs/archive/typescript_migration.md.

scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern frontend/app.js frontend/nimbus-intelligence.js frontend/nimbus-compute-core.js frontend/locales "frontend/**/*.mjs" "frontend/**/*.mts" "frontend/**/*.d.ts" frontend/nimbus-worker.ts scripts tests/modules
scripts.lint:errors: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern frontend/app.js frontend/nimbus-intelligence.js frontend/nimbus-compute-core.js frontend/locales "frontend/**/*.mts" "frontend/**/*.d.ts" frontend/nimbus-worker.ts --quiet
scripts.lint:ci: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern frontend/app.js frontend/nimbus-intelligence.js frontend/nimbus-compute-core.js "frontend/**/*.mjs" "frontend/**/*.mts" "frontend/**/*.d.ts" frontend/nimbus-worker.ts scripts tests/modules --quiet
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:modules
scripts.generate:api-types: python scripts/dump_openapi.py > frontend/types/.openapi-schema.json && openapi-typescript frontend/types/.openapi-schema.json -o frontend/types/api-generated.d.mts
